rules.statement: P4 is a more solemn document than D3 where the declarant was bound by statute to declare the truth.
rules.supporting_quote: P4 is a more solemn document than D3 where the declarant was bound by statute to declare the truth. Sections 32(5), 32(6) and 50 of the Evidence Ordinance refer to relevance and admissibility and not to presumptions. But such evidence can always be countered by other evidence, as in this case, by evidence more convincing and cogent

rules.statement: Evidence of relevance and admissibility can be rebutted by more convincing and cogent evidence.
